gold_note: Paravian reduced consensus, read by eye. Two large fans: the ornithurine node (seven tips and the neognath clade) and the dromaeosaurid node (nine tips, the Austroraptor-Unenlagia pair and the eudromaeosaurs, entered at Buitreraptor's height). Further multi-way nodes: four dromaeosaurines and four velociraptorines. No clade names are printed; the numbers are Bremer values. 66 tips, 4 polytomies (8, 11, 4, 4 children). Random-sample case (seed 20261122). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
